justification: Ground truth: Lemma metabelian_injectivity (lines 0528-0536) is false; witness V_0=Q_p{x,y,z}, Lbar = F/(Sym-hat(V_0)*[x,[x,y]]), v=x kills a=[x,y] in gr_2. The assessment explicitly judged 0528-0536 'OK as a statement ... an immediate corollary as claimed', so it did not target the ground-truth defect. It reported INVALID at line 0687 instead. I checked that flaw concretely and it is genuine: by the Bloch-Kato corollary at 0673-0679, dim H^1_f(G_{Q,T},Wbar_i) = dim D_dR(Wbar_i)/F^0 - dim H^0(G_R,Wbar_i), so the LHS of 0687 equals [dim D_dR(W_i)/F^0 - dim D_dR(Wbar_i)/F^0] + dim Wbar_i^{c=1}. Since Wbar_i = cap_sigma sigma W_i is contained in W_i, and equals W_i whenever W_i is Galois stable, the LHS is then exactly dim W_i^{c=1}, while the stated RHS dim W_i - dim(W_i ∩ gr_i(U_n)^{c=1}) is dim W_i^{c=-1}. The asserted inequality is therefore dim W_i^{c=1} >= dim W_i^{c=-1}, which fails concretely: for a genus-g>1 curve over Q with V = H^1(X)^* (c-eigenspaces of dim g each), gr_2 sits inside ∧^2 V whose c=+1 part has dim g(g-1) and c=-1 part dim g^2, so the c=-1 part is strictly larger. Moreover 0689 invokes silly_injectivity, which yields W_i^{c=-1} ↪ W_{i+1}/W_{i+1}^{c=-1} ≅ W_{i+1}^{c=1}, i.e. nonvanishing of the c=+1 parts, not of the c=-1 parts that the written RHS measures; the parallel case-(1) computation at 0629 subtracts dim Wbar_i^{c=-1}, confirming the eigenvalue at 0687 is the wrong one. So the Bloch-Kato branch of case (2) is not established as written. Different defect from the ground truth, but verified genuine.
